say:1:1061202001:1.text: My goodness... my ducks are all gone!
say:1:1061202001:1.source_cn: 呜呜……我的鸭子都不见了！
say:1:1061202001:1.male: My goodness... my ducks are all gone!
say:1:1061202001:1.female: My goodness... my ducks are all gone!

say:2:1061202002:1.text: The black ooze coming up out of the ground has burned away my fence, and all my ducks ran away!
say:2:1061202002:1.source_cn: 地上冒出的那些黑色污水腐化了我家院子的围栏，饲养的鸭子...
say:2:1061202002:1.male: The black ooze coming up out of the ground has burned away my fence, and all my ducks ran away!
say:2:1061202002:1.female: The black ooze coming up out of the ground has burned away my fence, and all my ducks ran away!

say:3:1061202003:1.text: The corruption is everywhere... Where can I find my ducks? Are they in danger?
say:3:1061202003:1.source_cn: 我该上哪找它们……现在到处都是腐化，它们会不会遇到危险啊？
say:3:1061202003:1.male: The corruption is everywhere... Where can I find my ducks? Are they in danger?
say:3:1061202003:1.female: The corruption is everywhere... Where can I find my ducks? Are they in danger?

choice_prompt:4:1061202003.text: The corruption is everywhere... Where can I find my ducks? Are they in danger?
choice_prompt:4:1061202003.source_cn: 我该上哪找它们……现在到处都是腐化，它们会不会遇到危险啊？
choice_prompt:4:1061202003.male: The corruption is everywhere... Where can I find my ducks? Are they in danger?
choice_prompt:4:1061202003.female: The corruption is everywhere... Where can I find my ducks? Are they in danger?

say:5:1061202004:1.text: Right! Walk along the riverside, and I might find them!
say:5:1061202004:1.source_cn: 对，你说得对！沿着河岸走，肯定能找到它们！
say:5:1061202004:1.male: Right! Walk along the riverside, and I might find them!
say:5:1061202004:1.female: Right! Walk along the riverside, and I might find them!

say:6:1061202005:1.text: But the village is a mess, and I have to take care of my family. I'm afraid I can't do it myself...
say:6:1061202005:1.source_cn: 可是现在村子里乱成一团，我还得照顾家里人，恐怕没办法去...
say:6:1061202005:1.male: But the village is a mess, and I have to take care of my family. I'm afraid I can't do it myself...
say:6:1061202005:1.female: But the village is a mess, and I have to take care of my family. I'm afraid I can't do it myself...

say:7:1061202006:1.text: Please help me, Outlander! All you have to do is hustle them back here.
say:7:1061202006:1.source_cn: 好心的异乡人，请你帮帮我吧！只要找到那些鸭子，把它们赶...
say:7:1061202006:1.male: Please help me, Outlander! All you have to do is hustle them back here.
say:7:1061202006:1.female: Please help me, Outlander! All you have to do is hustle them back here.
